Prescription:LOVE

A downloadable Yandere Visual Novel for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Download NowName your own price

LivingSlimeee



"You wake up in a hospital with no memory of how you got there. A kind and attentive doctor assures you that you will be under his care, patiently nursing you back to health. No one seems to know what caused your condition. "

Will you recover your lost memories...?  Or has he made sure you never will?

THIS IS A DEMO. VISUAL NOVEL IS STILL UNDER DEVELOPMENT ♡


  • Gender neutral writing
  • 1 Bad Ending, 1 Neutral Ending (Story progression)
  • Original artwork
  • Playtime : 40 minutes - 1 hour
  • 1 Caring Doctor ♡

Coding, Artwork, Story: LivingSlime

SFX & BGM : PixaBay , Dova Syndrome, Wingless-Seraph

GUI: NovelKit

  • Depiction of Death 
  • Screen Shake
  • Mild Flashing Imagery

THIS GAME IS RATED 17+. PLAYER DISCRETION IS ADVISE

Ren'Py (the engine used to build this game) uses Python, and sometimes antivirus detectors will tag it due to the download being from an "unknown" source (aka, not from a big company, like Adobe or Microsoft)

If you encounter any issues during installation, here are some steps you can take:

  1. Disable your firewall or antivirus software temporarily during the download and installation process. This should prevent it from mistakenly flagging the game.
  2. After installation is complete, you can re-enable your firewall/antivirus.
  3. If your system still blocks the installation, try adding the game to your antivirus "exceptions" list.

If there is any issues running the game, please try locating  %appdata% > Renpy folder > deleting the Prescription:LOVE folder. This will wipe all save data but will help the game run smoother.

actually, there is no proof that she used AI in "Where Eternity Sleeps". the AI accusations were pretty much entirely baseless. from what i can tell, a couple people online unfortunately assumed it was AI due to shifts/improvements her art style, and because the art style was "too perfect", everyone kinda took that and ran with it, and she was harassed into abandoning the game and any social media accounts associated with the game's development. i will say, the art style does slightly resemble the ai anime art style, but ai art is based off of human art, and the in-game sprites don't have the inconsistencies and disfigurements that an ai model would've produced at the time (taking into account the time it would've taken to make and finalize the demo). the line art and shading all look human-made, i think it's the hair shinies, iris coloring and airbrushed look that throws people off.
